text_block_list.text:
...I discovered martial arts, discovered 
racing, and overcame countless trials.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"With how I am now, I may finally reach 
it— the secret technique of Yaegaki, 
crushing stone with a single finger!"
